title: Find the External Gearshift Controls
introduction:
This component map covers the Mustang with the 6-Speed Manual Transmission – 3160. I start at the grip at the top of the drawing, look at the covering beneath it, then follow the external assembly toward the gray transmission. Think of it as a street map for the shifter: useful for finding your bearings before reaching for tools.

Match the drawing’s callouts to the table’s Item and Description columns. The table identifies the named components but supplies no ordering part numbers. The illustration shows their relationship to the transmission; it does not provide removal, adjustment or diagnostic instructions.

edits.why: Use the drawing and its matching table together to identify the external controls. The surrounding linkage provides location context; only the components identified by the callouts and table are named by this reference.
